needed.evidence: Footway is less than 1m wide and informal paths are partially usable due to obstruction
needed.suggestion: Construct a purpose-built, 1.5m-wide sidewalk along the obstructed side with continuous access.

needed.evidence: Obstructions on the footway include parked vehicles and other items that reduce its efficient use
needed.suggestion: Remove all obstructions to ensure a clear, unencumbered footway for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Obstructions on the footway including parked vehicles and other elements
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions and ensure a clear footway for safe pedestrian passage.

needed.evidence: Broken or uneven sections on the left sidewalk that pose trip hazards
needed.suggestion: Resurface and level the sidewalk to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: Marked pedestrian crossing without a refuge on a wide road, posing risks for crossing pedestrians
needed.suggestion: Install a signalised crossing with a refuge island to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Wide road without refuge on a marked crossing
needed.suggestion: Add a refuge island in the center of the crossing to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Missing dropped kerbs on one side of the crossing
needed.suggestion: Install dropped kerbs on both sides of the pedestrian crossing to ensure accessibility.
